name: obsidian
description: Obsidian commit-context capture, verified runtime setup, and guided MCP connection onboarding for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Capture commit context and set up Obsidian connections
interface.longDescription: Preserve Codex commit context, verify the public runtime, and guide separately authorized MCP registration through the Codex CLI with credential references. Existing approval policy is preserved; native capture, writer handoff, and hooks remain separate.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $commit-capture to save the latest successful commit and its conversation context to Obsidian.
